## Installation

You can install the development version of paparazzi from GitHub:

```r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("posit-dev/paparazzi")
```

### Additional requirements

paparazzi controls Chrome (or another Chromium-based browser) through [chromote](https://rstudio.github.io/chromote/), so you'll need one installed. If chromote can't find it, see `?chromote::find_chrome`.

paparazzi routes each recording to the encoder that suits it best: MP4 and WebM videos go to the [av](https://docs.ropensci.org/av/) package, GIFs to [gifski](https://r-rust.github.io/gifski/). These are suggested dependencies, checked only when a recording needs them. Simple GIFs need only gifski, but two features call in extra packages: cropping a GIF to a framed region of the page needs [png](https://cran.r-project.org/package=png), and camera movement or burned-in captions need av to composite the frames.
